create.name: Lama Surya Das
create.bio:
Lama Surya Das is an American-born teacher of Tibetan Buddhism, authorised as a lama and lineage holder in the Nyingma school. Over several decades he trained in Zen, vipassana and yoga as well as in the Tibetan tradition, studying with senior Asian masters, and he twice finished the traditional three-year cloistered retreat at his teacher's monastery. Introducing Westerners to Dzogchen, the Tibetan teaching of the Natural Great Perfection, has been the core of his work, and he presents it as resting in open, relaxed awareness rather than as an elaborate technique.

He founded the Dzogchen Center and Foundation, which began in Cambridge, Massachusetts, and he lives in nearby Lexington. Through the centre he leads retreats in person and on Zoom, gives private teaching sessions online, and guides a small invited group of long-term students in the AH Dzogchen Transmission Project; senior students also host a free weekly meditation gathering. Together with the Dalai Lama he started the Western Buddhist Teachers Network and has long taken part in interfaith work. His many books include the Awakening trilogy, which opens with Awakening the Buddha Within, as well as Buddha Standard Time and Make Me One with Everything.

books.title: Awakening the Buddha Within: Tibetan Wisdom for the Western World
books.author: Lama Surya Das
books.description: The first book of his Awakening trilogy and his best-known work. It sets out the Tibetan Buddhist path for Western readers, with practices drawn from the Dzogchen tradition.

books.title: Awakening to the Sacred: Creating a Spiritual Life from Scratch
books.author: Lama Surya Das
books.description: The second book of the trilogy, on building a personal spiritual practice from the ground up, whatever one's background.

books.title: Awakening the Buddhist Heart: Integrating Love, Meaning and Connection into Every Part of Your Life
books.author: Lama Surya Das
books.description: The third book of the trilogy, centred on relationship: with oneself, with others and with the world, seen through Buddhist teachings on love and compassion.

books.title: Buddha Standard Time: Awakening to the Infinite Possibilities of Now
books.author: Lama Surya Das
books.description: A book about our relationship with time and busyness, offering ways to meet each moment with more presence and less hurry.

books.title: Make Me One with Everything: Buddhist Meditations to Awaken from the Illusion of Separation
books.author: Lama Surya Das
books.description: A set of meditations aimed at loosening the sense of a separate self and seeing our connection with people, nature and the wider world.

books.title: Buddha Is as Buddha Does: The Ten Transformative Practices of Enlightened Living
books.author: Lama Surya Das
books.description: A guide to the ten paramitas, the classic Buddhist perfections such as generosity, patience and wisdom, as practices for daily life.

books.title: Letting Go of the Person You Used to Be: Lessons on Change, Loss and Spiritual Transformation
books.author: Lama Surya Das
books.description: Reflections on impermanence and on meeting life's changes with openness, drawing on Buddhist teaching and his own experience.

books.title: The Big Questions: How to Find Your Own Answers to Life's Essential Mysteries
books.author: Lama Surya Das
books.description: A book of inquiry into questions of meaning, purpose and faith, encouraging readers to work out their own answers through contemplation.

books.title: The Mind Is Mightier Than the Sword: Enlightening the Mind, Opening the Heart
books.author: Lama Surya Das
books.description: A collection of short Buddhist teachings and reflections on working with the mind and opening the heart.

books.title: Natural Great Perfection: Dzogchen Teachings and Vajra Songs
books.author: Nyoshul Khenpo and Lama Surya Das
books.description: Dzogchen teachings and songs of realisation by his teacher Nyoshul Khenpo, translated and presented with Surya Das.

courses.title: Private Teaching Sessions with Lama Surya Das
courses.description: One-hour sessions on Zoom for students who want personal guidance on meditation and the spiritual path. Rates and times are given on request by email.

free_resources.title: Virtual Meditation Town Hall
free_resources.description: A free hour on Zoom every Sunday at 11am US Eastern, in which senior Dzogchen Center students lead meditation and prayers and give a short teaching. Donations are welcome.
